class.name: JRPGCommonEventCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: runs a common event, then goes on.
class.description: Runs common event [member common_event_id] like a subroutine: the event goes on with its next command once the common event has finished. A common event the database lacks, or one called too deep (a common event that calls itself), is skipped with a warning ([method JRPGInterpreter.call_common_event]). Authority: server.
